summary: Adopt and update a host name's record

parameters.name: recordID
parameters.description: ID of the dynamic DNS record of a host name, as the list shows it

200.description: The name state after the write (`ok`, or `failed` with the provider's message)

400.description: The record is not a name that holds another record, or it cannot be adopted (`error.host-dns-adopt-refused`)

403.description: The user lacks a needed right

404.description: The record or its host does not exist or the user may not see it

description:
A name of a host held another single address, so nothing was written. This takes the record over: the Dynamic DNS updater owns it from now on and writes the wanted address now, the old value goes into the record's history. A set with more than one value or a CNAME cannot be adopted. An adopted record is never deleted at the provider.

Needs: the manage right of the record's host type and Certificates manage, the credential visible
